profile.headline: Software Developer at J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the automotive industry. Skilled in Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, Databases, Jenkins, and Scripting. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Engineering focused in Computer Software Engineering from Texas A&M University, Dwight Look College of Engineering	College.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Utilized Spring Boot, Maven, and SQL in Java to develop RESTful APIs.
•	Utilized Bootstrap, Spring Boot, Maven, and Javascript to develop front-end applications
that communicated with microservices.
•	Coordinated Releases with Management, Operations, Architects, and the Business.
•	Create a script to cross reference database records from multiple NAS and migrate unique files to ECS storage
•	Reviewed code in Bitbucket to ensure code quality.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Created a window form application in C# to test the next version of DeltaV.
o	 over 50 unit tests to verify the application could handle any case.
o	Participated in code collaborator before checking in my code to the TFS in Visual Studio.
•	Designed a total of 15 class and collaboration diagrams for an internal tool.
•	Collaborated with team members to create integration tests needed for nightly build tests.
•	Analyzed Visual Studio 2015 and C# 6.0 to present it to over 9 teams on how it would make an impact to some of the source code.
•	Deserialize scripts to compare data between the different layers of the software.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Collaborated with housing report that determined if property was worth investing.
Kept house insurance policies up to date by identifying and renewing expiring policies.
Helped manage contractors by inspecting job sites and recording expenses.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Set up hardware for desktops and servers.
Cross-referenced databases for two different systems to identify duplications.
Designed operator interfaces to help users control water plants.
Inspected equipment on the field.
